description: Risk-tiered allowlist + extra PreToolUse guard hooks for the webapp plugin. Consumed by /onboard. balanced mirrors plugins/webapp/commands/setup.md. cautious narrows to fast read-only checks; permissive adds broader build/test probes. Hooks hard-block publish/migration/expensive mutations per tier on top of the plugin floor.

hooks.command: bash -c 'if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE "npm publish|yarn publish|pnpm publish" 2>/dev/null; then echo "[onboard:cautious:npm-publish] Package publish is blocked at the cautious tier. Ask the user for explicit approval." && exit 2; fi'

bash -c 'if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE "drizzle-kit (generate|migrate|push|drop)|prisma migrate|prisma db push" 2>/dev/null; then echo "[onboard:cautious:db-migration] Schema/migration commands are blocked at the cautious tier. Review the generated SQL, then ask the user for explicit approval." && exit 2; fi'

bash -c 'if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE "rm +(-[a-zA-Z]*r|-[a-zA-Z]*f)[^|]*node_modules" 2>/dev/null; then echo "[onboard:cautious:rm-node-modules] Recursive deletion of node_modules is blocked at the cautious tier. Ask the user for explicit approval." && exit 2; fi'

bash -c 'if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE "npm publish|yarn publish|pnpm publish" 2>/dev/null; then echo "[onboard:balanced:npm-publish] Package publish is blocked at the balanced tier. Ask the user for explicit approval." && exit 2; fi'

bash -c 'if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE "drizzle-kit (generate|migrate|push|drop)|prisma migrate|prisma db push" 2>/dev/null; then echo "[onboard:balanced:db-migration] Schema/migration commands are blocked at the balanced tier. Review the generated SQL, then ask the user for explicit approval." && exit 2; fi'
